features: WORKS ON EVERY LAPTOP, INCLUDING USB-C MACBOOKS – Comes with a Type-C adapter in the box, so it fits USB-A and USB-C ports. Tested on Windows, macOS and Linux, including locked-down corporate laptops.
TURNS ON IN 3 SECONDS, NO SOFTWARE – Plug in, hold the button for 3 seconds, and the green light confirms it's working. No drivers, no admin rights, nothing to install.

SHOWS UP AS A STANDARD MOUSE – Your computer sees it as a normal HID mouse, so there is no app for IT tools to flag. Keeps Teams, Slack and Zoom status active and stops screen lock during downloads, renders and presentations.

3 MOVEMENT MODES, REMEMBERS YOUR SETTING – Mode 1 is a near-invisible micro-jiggle you can work over. Modes 2 and 3 are wider movements for longer breaks. Short press to switch modes. It remembers the last mode after unplugging.
METAL BODY, 1-YEAR WARRANTY, INDIAN SUPPORT – Solid metal shell, not plastic. Designed by MillionHz in India with a 1-year replacement warranty and WhatsApp support.
